"""
Master runner: Full pipeline across all 8 Joy of VEX episodes.

Runs Stages 1-8 with the lessons learned from the single-episode test:
  - Uses --ffmpeg-location for yt-dlp
  - Uses Claude Vision (04b) instead of tesseract (04)
  - Applies higher frame diff threshold to reduce redundant code frames

Usage: python scripts/run_all_episodes.py [--skip-download] [--skip-frames] [--resume-from STAGE]

Requires: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable
"""

import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

# --- Configuration ---
PLAYLIST_URL = "https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLTXmnikJEYnBtSfn4LwKx5vpopwrInp18"
PROJECT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
DATA_DIR = PROJECT_DIR / "data"

# Tool paths (Windows)
FFMPEG_DIR = Path(r"C:\Users\User\AppData\Local\Microsoft\WinGet\Packages\Gyan.FFmpeg_Microsoft.Winget.Source_8wekyb3d8bbwe\ffmpeg-8.0.1-full_build\bin")
FFMPEG = str(FFMPEG_DIR / "ffmpeg.exe")
YT_DLP = shutil.which("yt-dlp") or str(Path(r"C:\Users\User\AppData\Roaming\Python\Python314\Scripts\yt-dlp.exe"))

# Directories
VIDEO_DIR = DATA_DIR / "videos"
SUB_DIR = DATA_DIR / "subs"
META_DIR = DATA_DIR / "metadata"
FRAME_DIR = DATA_DIR / "frames"
CODE_DIR = DATA_DIR / "code_frames"
OCR_DIR = DATA_DIR / "ocr"
TRANSCRIPT_DIR = DATA_DIR / "transcripts"
ALIGNED_DIR = DATA_DIR / "aligned"
STRUCTURED_DIR = DATA_DIR / "structured"

for d in [VIDEO_DIR, SUB_DIR, META_DIR, FRAME_DIR, CODE_DIR, OCR_DIR,
          TRANSCRIPT_DIR, ALIGNED_DIR, STRUCTURED_DIR, PROJECT_DIR / "output"]:
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# Parse args
SKIP_DOWNLOAD = "--skip-download" in sys.argv
SKIP_FRAMES = "--skip-frames" in sys.argv
RESUME_FROM = 1
if "--resume-from" in sys.argv:
    idx = sys.argv.index("--resume-from")
    RESUME_FROM = int(sys.argv[idx + 1])


def banner(stage, desc):
    print(f"\n{'=' * 60}")
    print(f"  STAGE {stage}: {desc}")
    print(f"{'=' * 60}\n")


# ============================================================
# STAGE 1: Download
# ============================================================
def stage_1_download():
    banner(1, "Download videos + subtitles")

    # Get playlist info
    print("Fetching playlist info...")
    result = subprocess.run(
        [YT_DLP, "--flat-playlist", "--dump-json", PLAYLIST_URL],
        capture_output=True, text=True,
    )
    entries = [json.loads(l) for l in result.stdout.strip().split("\n") if l.strip()]
    print(f"Found {len(entries)} episodes.\n")

    index_data = []
    for i, entry in enumerate(entries, 1):
        video_id = entry.get("id", entry.get("url", ""))
        title = entry.get("title", f"episode_{i}")
        safe_title = re.sub(r"[^\w\s-]", "", title).strip().replace(" ", "_")[:60]
        filename_base = f"{i:02d}_{safe_title}"

        video_file = VIDEO_DIR / f"{filename_base}.mp4"
        if video_file.exists():
            print(f"  [{i}/{len(entries)}] SKIP (exists): {filename_base}")
            index_data.append({
                "index": i, "video_id": video_id, "title": title,
                "filename_base": filename_base,
                "url": f"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={video_id}",
            })
            continue

        print(f"  [{i}/{len(entries)}] Downloading: {title}")
        video_url = f"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={video_id}"

        try:
            subprocess.run([
                YT_DLP,
                "-f", "bestvideo[height<=720]+bestaudio/best[height<=720]",
                "--merge-output-format", "mp4",
                "--ffmpeg-location", str(FFMPEG_DIR),
                "-o", str(VIDEO_DIR / f"{filename_base}.mp4"),
                "--write-auto-sub",
                "--sub-lang", "en",
                "--sub-format", "vtt",
                "--convert-subs", "vtt",
                video_url,
            ], check=True)

            # Move VTT files from video dir to subs dir
            for vtt in VIDEO_DIR.glob(f"{filename_base}*.vtt"):
                vtt.rename(SUB_DIR / vtt.name)

            index_data.append({
                "index": i, "video_id": video_id, "title": title,
                "filename_base": filename_base, "url": video_url,
            })
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"    ERROR: {e}")
            index_data.append({
                "index": i, "title": title, "error": str(e),
            })

    with open(META_DIR / "playlist_index.json", "w") as f:
        json.dump(index_data, f, indent=2, sort_keys=False)

    ok = sum(1 for x in index_data if "error" not in x)
    print(f"\nDownloaded {ok}/{len(entries)} episodes.")
    return index_data


# ============================================================
# STAGE 2: Frame Extraction
# ============================================================
def stage_2_frames(playlist):
    banner(2, "Extract frames at 0.5fps")

    for entry in playlist:
        if "error" in entry:
            continue
        video_file = VIDEO_DIR / f"{entry['filename_base']}.mp4"
        episode_dir = FRAME_DIR / entry["filename_base"]

        if episode_dir.exists() and len(list(episode_dir.glob("*.png"))) > 100:
            print(f"  SKIP (exists): {entry['filename_base']}")
            continue

        if not video_file.exists():
            print(f"  SKIP (no video): {entry['filename_base']}")
            continue

        episode_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        print(f"  Extracting: {entry['filename_base']}...")
        subprocess.run([
            FFMPEG, "-i", str(video_file),
            "-vf", "fps=0.5",
            "-q:v", "2",
            str(episode_dir / "frame_%05d.png"),
            "-y",
        ], capture_output=True, check=True)
        n = len(list(episode_dir.glob("*.png")))
        print(f"    -> {n} frames")


# ============================================================
# STAGE 3: Code Frame Detection (with higher diff threshold)
# ============================================================
def stage_3_detect(playlist):
    banner(3, "Detect code frames (diff_threshold=0.04)")

    import cv2
    import numpy as np

    DARK_THRESHOLD = 80
    DARK_RATIO_MIN = 0.25
    EDGE_DENSITY_MIN = 0.02
    DIFF_THRESHOLD = 0.04  # Raised from 0.015 to reduce near-duplicates

    def is_code_frame(frame):
        gray = cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
        h, w = gray.shape
        dark_mask = gray < DARK_THRESHOLD
        dark_ratio = np.sum(dark_mask) / (h * w)
        if dark_ratio < DARK_RATIO_MIN:
            return False, 0.0, {}
        edges = cv2.Canny(gray, 50, 150)
        text_edges = edges & (dark_mask.astype(np.uint8) * 255)
        edge_density = np.sum(text_edges > 0) / max(np.sum(dark_mask), 1)
        if edge_density < EDGE_DENSITY_MIN:
            return False, 0.0, {}
        horiz_k = cv2.getStructuringElement(cv2.MORPH_RECT, (25, 1))
        horiz = cv2.morphologyEx(text_edges, cv2.MORPH_OPEN, horiz_k)
        line_ratio = np.sum(horiz > 0) / max(np.sum(text_edges > 0), 1)
        conf = min(1.0, dark_ratio * 0.3 + edge_density * 10 * 0.4 + line_ratio * 0.3)
        return conf > 0.3, conf, {
            "dark_ratio": round(float(dark_ratio), 3),
            "edge_density": round(float(edge_density), 4),
            "line_ratio": round(float(line_ratio), 3),
        }

    def frames_differ(a, b):
        if a is None or b is None:
            return True
        ga = cv2.cvtColor(a, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
        gb = cv2.cvtColor(b, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
        diff = cv2.absdiff(ga, gb)
        return np.sum(diff > 30) / diff.size > DIFF_THRESHOLD

    for entry in playlist:
        if "error" in entry:
            continue
        frame_dir = FRAME_DIR / entry["filename_base"]
        out_dir = CODE_DIR / entry["filename_base"]

        if out_dir.exists() and (out_dir / "detections.json").exists():
            with open(out_dir / "detections.json") as f:
                existing = json.load(f)
            print(f"  SKIP (exists): {entry['filename_base']} ({len(existing)} detections)")
            continue

        frames = sorted(frame_dir.glob("frame_*.png"))
        if not frames:
            continue

        out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        detections = []
        last_code = None

        print(f"  Detecting: {entry['filename_base']} ({len(frames)} frames)...")
        for fp in frames:
            frame = cv2.imread(str(fp))
            if frame is None:
                continue
            is_code, conf, meta = is_code_frame(frame)
            if is_code and frames_differ(frame, last_code):
                frame_num = int(fp.stem.split("_")[1])
                ts = frame_num * 2
                shutil.copy2(fp, out_dir / fp.name)
                detections.append({
                    "frame": fp.name,
                    "timestamp_sec": ts,
                    "timestamp_fmt": f"{ts // 60}:{ts % 60:02d}",
                    "confidence": round(float(conf), 3),
                    "metadata": meta,
                })
                last_code = frame.copy()

        with open(out_dir / "detections.json", "w") as f:
            json.dump(detections, f, indent=2)
        print(f"    -> {len(detections)} unique code frames")


# ============================================================
# STAGE 4b: Vision OCR (Claude)
# ============================================================
def stage_4_vision_ocr(playlist):
    banner("4b", "Vision OCR with Claude")

    import base64
    from anthropic import Anthropic

    client = Anthropic(api_key=os.environ["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"])

    PROMPT = """Look at this screenshot of Houdini (3D software).

Extract any VEX code visible in the image. VEX code appears in:
1. The VEX/expression editor (dark panel with monospaced text)
2. Web browser panels showing code snippets
3. Parameter fields containing VEX expressions

Rules:
- Extract ONLY VEX code, not menu text or button labels
- Preserve exact formatting (line breaks, indentation)
- If multiple distinct code snippets are visible, keep only the most complete/final version
- If NO VEX code is visible, respond with exactly: NO_CODE
- Include attribute bindings (@P, @Cd, etc.) as they appear

Respond with ONLY the extracted code (or NO_CODE). No explanation, no markdown fences."""

    for entry in playlist:
        if "error" in entry:
            continue
        episode_name = entry["filename_base"]
        episode_dir = CODE_DIR / episode_name
        det_file = episode_dir / "detections.json"
        out_file = OCR_DIR / f"{episode_name}.json"

        if out_file.exists():
            with open(out_file) as f:
                existing = json.load(f)
            if existing and existing[0].get("extraction_method") == "claude_vision":
                print(f"  SKIP (exists): {episode_name} ({len(existing)} blocks)")
                continue

        if not det_file.exists():
            continue

        with open(det_file) as f:
            dets = json.load(f)

        print(f"  Processing: {episode_name} ({len(dets)} frames)...")
        results = []
        for i, det in enumerate(dets):
            fp = episode_dir / det["frame"]
            if not fp.exists():
                continue

            with open(fp, "rb") as f:
                img_b64 = base64.standard_b64encode(f.read()).decode("utf-8")

            try:
                resp = client.messages.create(
                    model="claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929",
                    max_tokens=1000,
                    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": [
                        {"type": "image", "source": {
                            "type": "base64", "media_type": "image/png", "data": img_b64}},
                        {"type": "text", "text": PROMPT},
                    ]}],
                )
                text = resp.content[0].text.strip()

                # Strip markdown fences if model added them
                if text.startswith("```"):
                    lines = text.split("\n")
                    text = "\n".join(lines[1:-1] if lines[-1].strip() == "```" else lines[1:])
                    text = text.strip()

                if text and text != "NO_CODE":
                    results.append({
                        "frame": det["frame"],
                        "timestamp_sec": det["timestamp_sec"],
                        "timestamp_fmt": det["timestamp_fmt"],
                        "code_text": text,
                        "ocr_confidence": 0.85,
                        "detection_confidence": det["confidence"],
                        "needs_review": False,
                        "extraction_method": "claude_vision",
                    })

            except Exception as e:
                print(f"    [{i+1}] Error: {e}")
                time.sleep(5)

            # Progress + rate limit
            if (i + 1) % 10 == 0:
                print(f"    [{i+1}/{len(dets)}] extracted {len(results)} code blocks so far")
            time.sleep(0.5)

        with open(out_file, "w") as f:
            json.dump(results, f, indent=2, sort_keys=False)

        no_code = len(dets) - len(results)
        print(f"    -> {len(results)} code blocks ({no_code} frames had no code)")


# ============================================================
# STAGE 5: Transcripts
# ============================================================
def stage_5_transcripts(playlist):
    banner(5, "Process VTT subtitles")

    import webvtt

    FILLER = [
        r"\b(um+|uh+|ah+|er+|hm+|hmm+)\b",
        r"\b(you know|like I said|basically|sort of|kind of)\b",
        r"\[.*?\]", r"\(.*?\)",
    ]

    def clean(text):
        for p in FILLER:
            text = re.sub(p, "", text, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
        return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()

    def time_to_sec(t):
        parts = t.replace(",", ".").split(":")
        if len(parts) == 3:
            return int(parts[0]) * 3600 + int(parts[1]) * 60 + float(parts[2])
        return int(parts[0]) * 60 + float(parts[1]) if len(parts) == 2 else 0

    for entry in playlist:
        if "error" in entry:
            continue
        ep = entry["filename_base"]
        out_file = TRANSCRIPT_DIR / f"{ep}.json"

        if out_file.exists():
            print(f"  SKIP (exists): {ep}")
            continue

        # Find VTT file
        vtt_candidates = list(SUB_DIR.glob(f"{ep}*"))
        if not vtt_candidates:
            print(f"  NO VTT: {ep}")
            continue

        vtt_path = vtt_candidates[0]
        segments = []
        try:
            for cap in webvtt.read(str(vtt_path)):
                text = clean(cap.text)
                if text and len(text) > 5:
                    segments.append({
                        "start": cap.start, "end": cap.end,
                        "start_sec": time_to_sec(cap.start),
                        "end_sec": time_to_sec(cap.end),
                        "text": text,
                    })
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"  ERROR parsing {vtt_path.name}: {e}")
            continue

        # Merge nearby segments
        merged = [segments[0].copy()] if segments else []
        for seg in segments[1:]:
            last = merged[-1]
            if seg["start_sec"] - last["end_sec"] < 2.0 and len(last["text"]) + len(seg["text"]) < 500:
                last["end"] = seg["end"]
                last["end_sec"] = seg["end_sec"]
                last["text"] += " " + seg["text"]
            else:
                merged.append(seg.copy())

        with open(out_file, "w") as f:
            json.dump(merged, f, indent=2)
        print(f"  {ep}: {len(merged)} segments")


# ============================================================
# STAGE 6: Alignment
# ============================================================
def stage_6_align(playlist):
    banner(6, "Temporal alignment")

    BEFORE = 30
    AFTER = 15

    playlist_index = {e["filename_base"]: e for e in playlist if "error" not in e}

    for ocr_file in sorted(OCR_DIR.glob("*.json")):
        ep = ocr_file.stem
        out_file = ALIGNED_DIR / f"{ep}.json"

        # Don't skip - re-align with latest OCR
        with open(ocr_file) as f:
            ocr_data = json.load(f)
        if not ocr_data:
            continue

        trans_file = TRANSCRIPT_DIR / f"{ep}.json"
        if not trans_file.exists():
            candidates = list(TRANSCRIPT_DIR.glob(f"{ep.split('.')[0]}*"))
            trans_file = candidates[0] if candidates else None
        if not trans_file or not trans_file.exists():
            print(f"  No transcript for {ep}")
            continue

        with open(trans_file) as f:
            transcript = json.load(f)

        aligned = []
        for i, cb in enumerate(ocr_data):
            ts = cb["timestamp_sec"]
            explanation = " ".join(
                seg["text"] for seg in transcript
                if seg.get("start_sec", 0) <= ts + AFTER
                and seg.get("end_sec", seg.get("start_sec", 0) + 5) >= ts - BEFORE
            )

            entry_meta = playlist_index.get(ep, {})
            vid = entry_meta.get("video_id", "")
            url = f"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={vid}&t={int(ts)}s" if vid else ""

            aligned.append({
                "sequence": i + 1,
                "episode_name": ep,
                "timestamp_sec": ts,
                "timestamp_fmt": cb["timestamp_fmt"],
                "youtube_url": url,
                "code_text": cb["code_text"],
                "explanation_raw": explanation,
                "ocr_confidence": cb["ocr_confidence"],
                "needs_review": cb.get("needs_review", False),
            })

        with open(out_file, "w") as f:
            json.dump(aligned, f, indent=2)
        print(f"  {ep}: {len(aligned)} aligned pairs")


# ============================================================
# STAGE 7: LLM Structuring
# ============================================================
def stage_7_structure(playlist):
    banner(7, "LLM structuring with Claude")

    from anthropic import Anthropic
    client = Anthropic(api_key=os.environ["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"])

    playlist_index = {e["filename_base"]: e for e in playlist if "error" not in e}

    SYSTEM = """You are a Houdini VEX expert structuring tutorial content for a RAG database.

You receive OCR'd VEX code and transcript explanation. Produce a structured JSON record.

RULES:
- Fix obvious OCR errors in code
- Ensure code is syntactically valid VEX
- Write explanation in clear technical prose (1-3 sentences)
- Extract ALL VEX functions and attribute bindings (@P, @Cd, etc.)
- If code has multiple variants separated by ---, keep only the most complete/final version
- Be conservative with difficulty ratings:
  beginner: basic attributes, simple expressions
  intermediate: point clouds, loops, channels, groups
  advanced: matrices, quaternions, custom solvers

OUTPUT: A single JSON object, no markdown wrapping."""

    SCHEMA = """Required fields:
- id: "joy_of_vex_ep{NN}_{NNN}"
- source: full episode title
- episode: integer
- timestamp: "MM:SS"
- youtube_url: string
- topic: 2-6 words
- code: cleaned VEX (single best version)
- explanation: 1-3 sentences
- vex_functions: array of strings
- vex_context: "SOP"|"DOP"|"COP"|"CVEX"|"unknown"
- node_context: e.g. "Attribute Wrangle"
- difficulty: "beginner"|"intermediate"|"advanced"
- category: one of [attributes, color, geometry_creation, geometry_manipulation, math_operations, noise_and_randomness, point_clouds, groups_and_selection, strings, arrays, volumes, simulation, ui_and_parameters, flow_control, debugging, optimization, other]
- related_concepts: array of strings
- prerequisites: array of IDs (can be [])
- builds_on: string ID or null
- ocr_confidence: number 0-1
- needs_review: boolean"""

    for aligned_file in sorted(ALIGNED_DIR.glob("*.json")):
        ep = aligned_file.stem
        out_file = STRUCTURED_DIR / f"{ep}.jsonl"

        if out_file.exists() and out_file.stat().st_size > 10:
            with open(out_file) as f:
                lines = [l for l in f if l.strip()]
            print(f"  SKIP (exists): {ep} ({len(lines)} records)")
            continue

        with open(aligned_file) as f:
            pairs = json.load(f)
        if not pairs:
            continue

        meta = playlist_index.get(ep, {})
        title = meta.get("title", ep)
        ep_num = meta.get("index", 0)

        print(f"  Processing: {ep} ({len(pairs)} pairs)...")
        records = []
        for pair in pairs:
            prompt = f"""Structure this VEX tutorial content into a JSON record.

Episode: {title} (Episode {ep_num})
Timestamp: {pair['timestamp_fmt']}
YouTube URL: {pair['youtube_url']}
Sequence: {pair['sequence']}

VEX Code:
{pair['code_text']}

Transcript context:
{pair['explanation_raw'][:1000]}

OCR Confidence: {pair['ocr_confidence']}

{SCHEMA}

Output JSON only."""

            try:
                resp = client.messages.create(
                    model="claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929",
                    max_tokens=2000,
                    system=SYSTEM,
                    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
                )
                text = resp.content[0].text.strip()
                if text.startswith("```"):
                    text = text.split("\n", 1)[1]
                    if text.endswith("```"):
                        text = text[:-3]
                    text = text.strip()
                records.append(json.loads(text))
            except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
                print(f"    seq={pair['sequence']}: JSON error: {e}")
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"    seq={pair['sequence']}: API error: {e}")
                time.sleep(5)

            time.sleep(1.0)

        with open(out_file, "w") as f:
            for r in records:
                f.write(json.dumps(r, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
        review = sum(1 for r in records if r.get("needs_review"))
        print(f"    -> {len(records)} records ({review} need review)")


# ============================================================
# STAGE 8: Validation + Assembly
# ============================================================
def stage_8_validate():
    banner(8, "Validation + final assembly")
    # Delegate to the existing script
    subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, str(PROJECT_DIR / "scripts" / "08_validate_and_assemble.py")],
        cwd=str(PROJECT_DIR),
        check=True,
    )


# ============================================================
# MAIN
# ============================================================
def main():
    if not os.environ.get("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"):
        print("ERROR: Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable")
        sys.exit(1)

    start = time.time()

    # Stage 1
    if RESUME_FROM <= 1 and not SKIP_DOWNLOAD:
        playlist = stage_1_download()
    else:
        with open(META_DIR / "playlist_index.json") as f:
            playlist = json.load(f)
        print(f"Loaded playlist index: {len(playlist)} episodes")

    valid = [e for e in playlist if "error" not in e]
    print(f"\n{len(valid)} episodes ready for processing.\n")

    # Stage 2
    if RESUME_FROM <= 2 and not SKIP_FRAMES:
        stage_2_frames(valid)

    # Stage 3
    if RESUME_FROM <= 3:
        stage_3_detect(valid)

    # Stage 4b (Vision OCR) + Stage 5 (Transcripts) -- independent, but sequential
    if RESUME_FROM <= 4:
        stage_5_transcripts(valid)  # Fast, run first
        stage_4_vision_ocr(valid)   # Slow, run after

    if RESUME_FROM <= 5 and RESUME_FROM > 4:
        stage_5_transcripts(valid)

    # Stage 6
    if RESUME_FROM <= 6:
        stage_6_align(valid)

    # Stage 7
    if RESUME_FROM <= 7:
        stage_7_structure(valid)

    # Stage 8
    stage_8_validate()

    elapsed = time.time() - start
    print(f"\n{'=' * 60}")
    print(f"  PIPELINE COMPLETE in {elapsed / 60:.1f} minutes")
    print(f"{'=' * 60}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

3. I installed dependencies: Python packages (yt-dlp, pytesseract, webvtt-py, anthropic, tqdm) and system tools (ffmpeg via winget, tesseract-ocr via winget).

4. Windows PATH issues were a major theme - ffmpeg and tesseract installed but not on PATH in current shell. Created `_tools.py` helper and `env_setup.sh`.

5. User asked to "run the pipeline on one episode first to test it" - I ran all 8 stages on episode 1.

6. Key finding: tesseract OCR produced garbage (reading entire Houdini UI), so I created `04b_vision_ocr.py` using Claude Vision API which worked excellently.

7. Single episode test completed: 8/8 valid records, 0 errors.

8. User asked to "run it on all 8 episodes" - I created `run_all_episodes.py` master script with improvements (higher frame diff threshold 0.04, ffmpeg-location flag, Vision OCR, skip-if-exists logic).

9. Pipeline is currently running in background (task b905801). Downloads complete for all 8 episodes, frame extraction complete, now in later stages (code detection, Vision OCR, etc.).

Key errors:
- yt-dlp couldn't find ffmpeg for merging → had to manually merge with ffmpeg, then fixed with --ffmpeg-location
- tesseract config string had unbalanced quotes breaking shlex → simplified to just "--psm 6 --oem 3"
- Python subprocess couldn't find ffmpeg on PATH → created _tools.py with known Windows paths
- tesseract OCR produced garbage on full Houdini UI frames → created 04b_vision_ocr.py with Claude Vision
- yt-dlp scripts not on PATH → used absolute paths or python -m yt_dlp

Files created:
- config/schema.json
- scripts/01_download.py through 08_validate_and_assemble.py
- scripts/run_pipeline.sh
- scripts/env_setup.sh
- scripts/_tools.py

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   The user provided a comprehensive specification for a **VEX Tutorial RAG Pipeline** — an 8-stage pipeline to process Matt Estela's "The Joy of VEX" YouTube playlist (8 episodes) into a structured JSONL dataset optimized for vector database ingestion and RAG retrieval. The pipeline stages are: (1) yt-dlp download, (2) ffmpeg frame extraction, (3) code frame detection via OpenCV heuristics, (4) OCR code extraction, (5) VTT transcript processing, (6) temporal alignment, (7) Claude API structuring, (8) validation + assembly. After initial scaffolding, user requested a single-episode test, then asked to run on all 8 episodes.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - **yt-dlp** for YouTube video/subtitle downloads with `--ffmpeg-location` flag for Windows
   - **ffmpeg** for frame extraction at 0.5fps
   - **OpenCV** for code frame detection (dark background heuristic + edge density + frame differencing)
   - **pytesseract** (initially, later abandoned) for OCR
   - **Claude Vision API** (replacement for tesseract) — dramatically better code extraction from Houdini screenshots
   - **webvtt-py** for VTT subtitle parsing
   - **Claude Sonnet 4.5 API** for structuring aligned pairs into schema-compliant JSONL
   - **JSONL schema** with fields: id, source, episode, timestamp, youtube_url, topic, code, explanation, vex_functions, vex_context, node_context, difficulty, category, related_concepts, prerequisites, builds_on, ocr_confidence, needs_review
   - **Frame diff threshold** tuning: 0.015 (original) → 0.04 (improved) to reduce near-duplicate code frames
   - **Windows PATH management** for winget-installed tools (ffmpeg, tesseract)

3. Files and Code Sections:

   - **`C:\Users\User\vex_rag_pipeline\config\schema.json`**
     - JSON Schema defining the JSONL record format with required fields, enum constraints, and patterns
     - No modifications after initial creation

   - **`C:\Users\User\vex_rag_pipeline\scripts\01_download.py`**
     - Downloads videos + auto-subs from YouTube playlist using yt-dlp
     - Modified from spec to handle VTT file relocation from videos/ to subs/ dir

   - **`C:\Users\User\vex_rag_pipeline\scripts\02_extract_frames.py`**
     - Extracts frames at 0.5fps using ffmpeg
     - **Modified** to import `_tools.py` for ffmpeg path resolution on Windows:
     ```python
     from _tools import ffmpeg as find_ffmpeg
     FFMPEG = find_ffmpeg()
     ```

   - **`C:\Users\User\vex_rag_pipeline\scripts\03_detect_code_frames.py`**
     - OpenCV-based code frame detection with dark region + edge density + horizontal line heuristics
     - Parameters: DARK_REGION_THRESHOLD=80, DARK_RATIO_MIN=0.25, TEXT_EDGE_DENSITY_MIN=0.02, FRAME_DIFF_THRESHOLD=0.015
     - Fixed: moved `import shutil` to top-level

   - **`C:\Users\User\vex_rag_pipeline\scripts\04_ocr_code.py`**
     - Original tesseract-based OCR (effectively deprecated by 04b)
     - **Modified** to use `_tools.py` for tesseract path, and simplified TESS_CONFIG from complex whitelist to just `"--psm 6 --oem 3"` to fix shlex parsing error

   - **`C:\Users\User\vex_rag_pipeline\scripts\04b_vision_ocr.py`** (NEW - key improvement)
     - Replaces tesseract with Claude Vision API for code extraction
     - Sends frame images as base64 to `claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929` with a prompt to extract only VEX code
     - Supports `--sample` flag for testing on subset
     - Returns 0.85 confidence for vision-extracted code
     - Critical improvement: tesseract produced ~0.42 avg confidence garbage; Vision produced clean, accurate VEX code

   - **`C:\Users\User\vex_rag_pipeline\scripts\05_process_transcripts.py`**
     - Parses VTT files, strips filler words/stream artifacts, merges fragmented segments
     - Supports fallback bulk transcript via `--transcript` flag

   - **`C:\Users\User\vex_rag_pipeline\scripts\06_align.py`**
     - Matches OCR code blocks with surrounding transcript text (30s before, 15s after)

   - **`C:\Users\User\vex_rag_pipeline\scripts\07_structure_jsonl.py`**
     - Sends aligned pairs to Claude Sonnet for structuring into schema-compliant JSON records
     - Rate limited at 1.5s between requests

   - **`C:\Users\User\vex_rag_pipeline\scripts\08_validate_and_assemble.py`**
     - Schema validation, VEX syntax checks, cross-reference integrity, duplicate detection
     - Produces: joy_of_vex_rag.jsonl, joy_of_vex_functions.json, joy_of_vex_reference.md, validation_report.json

   - **`C:\Users\User\vex_rag_pipeline\scripts\_tools.py`** (NEW)
     - Shared utility to locate ffmpeg and tesseract on Windows via known install paths:
     ```python

     - Sources PATH additions for bash sessions

   - **`C:\Users\User\vex_rag_pipeline\scripts\run_pipeline.sh`**
     - Bash runner for sequential stage execution, modified to source env_setup.sh

   - **`C:\Users\User\vex_rag_pipeline\scripts\run_all_episodes.py`** (NEW - master runner for all 8 episodes)
     - Self-contained Python script running all stages with improvements:
       - `--ffmpeg-location` flag for yt-dlp
       - Higher frame diff threshold (0.04 vs 0.015)
       - Claude Vision OCR (stage 4b) instead of tesseract
       - Skip-if-exists logic for resumability
       - `--skip-download`, `--skip-frames`, `--resume-from STAGE` flags
     - Handles Windows paths natively via hardcoded tool locations

4. Errors and Fixes:
   - **yt-dlp couldn't merge video+audio streams**: ffmpeg not on PATH during download. Fixed by: (a) manually merging with ffmpeg absolute path for ep1 test, (b) adding `--ffmpeg-location` flag to yt-dlp in `run_all_episodes.py`
   - **tesseract config `shlex.split()` ValueError "No closing quotation"**: The TESS_CONFIG string contained literal quote characters (`"'"`) that broke shlex parsing in pytesseract. Fixed by simplifying to `"--psm 6 --oem 3"` (removed character whitelist entirely)
   - **Python subprocess FileNotFoundError for ffmpeg**: `subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", ...])` failed because PATH not inherited from bash. Fixed by creating `_tools.py` with `find_tool()` that checks known Windows install paths
   - **Tesseract OCR producing garbage text**: OCR read entire Houdini UI (menus, buttons) instead of isolating VEX code editor. Mean confidence ~0.42, output was garbled nonsense. Fixed by creating `04b_vision_ocr.py` using Claude Vision API, which correctly extracted VEX code with 0.85 confidence
   - **Git Bash PATH export issues**: `export PATH="..." && command` sometimes failed to resolve in Git Bash. Worked around by using absolute paths to executables

"""
Master runner: Full pipeline across all 8 Joy of VEX episodes.

Runs Stages 1-8 with the lessons learned from the single-episode test:
  - Uses --ffmpeg-location for yt-dlp
  - Uses Claude Vision (04b) instead of tesseract (04)
  - Applies higher frame diff threshold to reduce redundant code frames

Usage: python scripts/run_all_episodes.py [--skip-download] [--skip-frames] [--resume-from STAGE]

Requires: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable
"""

import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

# --- Configuration ---
PLAYLIST_URL = "https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLTXmnikJEYnBtSfn4LwKx5vpopwrInp18"
PROJECT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
DATA_DIR = PROJECT_DIR / "data"

# Tool paths (Windows)
FFMPEG_DIR = Path(r"C:\Users\User\AppData\Local\Microsoft\WinGet\Packages\Gyan.FFmpeg_Microsoft.Winget.Source_8wekyb3d8bbwe\ffmpeg-8.0.1-full_build\bin")
FFMPEG = str(FFMPEG_DIR / "ffmpeg.exe")
YT_DLP = shutil.which("yt-dlp") or str(Path(r"C:\Users\User\AppData\Roaming\Python\Python314\Scripts\yt-dlp.exe"))

# Directories
VIDEO_DIR = DATA_DIR / "videos"
SUB_DIR = DATA_DIR / "subs"
META_DIR = DATA_DIR / "metadata"
FRAME_DIR = DATA_DIR / "frames"
CODE_DIR = DATA_DIR / "code_frames"
OCR_DIR = DATA_DIR / "ocr"
TRANSCRIPT_DIR = DATA_DIR / "transcripts"
ALIGNED_DIR = DATA_DIR / "aligned"
STRUCTURED_DIR = DATA_DIR / "structured"

for d in [VIDEO_DIR, SUB_DIR, META_DIR, FRAME_DIR, CODE_DIR, OCR_DIR,
          TRANSCRIPT_DIR, ALIGNED_DIR, STRUCTURED_DIR, PROJECT_DIR / "output"]:
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# Parse args
SKIP_DOWNLOAD = "--skip-download" in sys.argv
SKIP_FRAMES = "--skip-frames" in sys.argv

1→"""
     2→Stage 7: Use Claude API to structure aligned code-explanation pairs
     3→into the final JSONL schema.
     4→
     5→The LLM receives verified code (from OCR) and verified explanation
     6→(from transcript). Its job is to:
     7→- Clean up OCR artifacts in code
     8→- Write a polished explanation
     9→- Classify and tag the snippet
    10→- Extract VEX function names
    11→- Assign difficulty and category
    12→
    13→Usage: python scripts/07_structure_jsonl.py [--api-key KEY]
    14→
    15→Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable or pass --api-key.
    16→
    17→Output: data/structured/{episode}.jsonl
    18→"""
    19→
    20→import json
    21→import os
    22→import sys
    23→import time
    24→from pathlib import Path
    25→
    26→from anthropic import Anthropic
    27→
    28→DATA_DIR = Path("data")
    29→ALIGNED_DIR = DATA_DIR / "aligned"
    30→STRUCTURED_DIR = DATA_DIR / "structured"
    31→META_DIR = DATA_DIR / "metadata"
    32→STRUCTURED_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    33→
    34→# Initialize Anthropic client
    35→api_key = os.environ.get("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY")
    36→if "--api-key" in sys.argv:
    37→    idx = sys.argv.index("--api-key")
    38→    api_key = sys.argv[idx + 1]
    39→
    40→if not api_key:
    41→    print("ERROR: Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or pass --api-key")
    42→    sys.exit(1)
    43→
    44→client = Anthropic(api_key=api_key)
    45→
    46→SYSTEM_PROMPT = """You are a Houdini VEX expert structuring tutorial content for a RAG database.
    47→
    48→You will receive:
    49→1. OCR'd VEX code (may have OCR artifacts -- clean it up)
    50→2. Transcript explanation (conversational -- distill it)
    51→3. Episode context
    52→
    53→Your job: Produce a structured JSON record for each code-explanation pair.
    54→
    55→RULES:
    56→- Fix obvious OCR errors in code (e.g., "0" vs "O", "@Cd" not "@cd")
    57→- Ensure code is syntactically valid VEX
    58→- Write explanation in clear technical prose (1-3 sentences)
    59→- Extract ALL VEX functions used (built-in functions AND attribute bindings like @P, @Cd)
    60→- Attribute bindings (@P, @N, @Cd, etc.) should be listed in vex_functions
    61→- If code is incomplete or clearly truncated, set needs_review=true
    62→- If code is a trivial modification of the previous snippet, note it in builds_on
    63→- Be conservative with difficulty ratings:
    64→  - beginner: basic attributes, simple expressions, @P/@Cd type work
    65→  - intermediate: point clouds, loops, channel references, groups
    66→  - advanced: matrices, quaternions, custom solvers, compiled blocks
    67→
    68→OUTPUT: A single JSON object (not wrapped in markdown code blocks). Must conform exactly to the schema."""
    69→
    70→SCHEMA_SUMMARY = """Required fields:
    71→- id: string, format "joy_of_vex_ep{NN}_{NNN}"
    72→- source: string, full episode title
    73→- episode: integer
    74→- timestamp: string, "MM:SS"
    75→- youtube_url: string
    76→- topic: string, 2-6 words
    77→- code: string, cleaned VEX code
    78→- explanation: string, 1-3 sentences
    79→- vex_functions: array of strings
    80→- vex_context: "SOP" | "DOP" | "COP" | "CVEX" | "unknown"

"""
Stage 7: Use Claude API to structure aligned code-explanation pairs
into the final JSONL schema.

The LLM receives verified code (from OCR) and verified explanation
(from transcript). Its job is to:
- Clean up OCR artifacts in code
- Write a polished explanation
- Classify and tag the snippet
- Extract VEX function names
- Assign difficulty and category

Usage: python scripts/07_structure_jsonl.py [--api-key KEY]

Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable or pass --api-key.

Output: data/structured/{episode}.jsonl
"""

import json
import os
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

from anthropic import Anthropic

DATA_DIR = Path("data")
ALIGNED_DIR = DATA_DIR / "aligned"
STRUCTURED_DIR = DATA_DIR / "structured"
META_DIR = DATA_DIR / "metadata"
STRUCTURED_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# Initialize Anthropic client
api_key = os.environ.get("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY")
if "--api-key" in sys.argv:
    idx = sys.argv.index("--api-key")
    api_key = sys.argv[idx + 1]

if not api_key:
    print("ERROR: Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or pass --api-key")
    sys.exit(1)

client = Anthropic(api_key=api_key)

SYSTEM_PROMPT = """You are a Houdini VEX expert structuring tutorial content for a RAG database.

You will receive:
1. OCR'd VEX code (may have OCR artifacts -- clean it up)
2. Transcript explanation (conversational -- distill it)
3. Episode context

Your job: Produce a structured JSON record for each code-explanation pair.

RULES:
- Fix obvious OCR errors in code (e.g., "0" vs "O", "@Cd" not "@cd")
- Ensure code is syntactically valid VEX
- Write explanation in clear technical prose (1-3 sentences)
- Extract ALL VEX functions used (built-in functions AND attribute bindings like @P, @Cd)
- Attribute bindings (@P, @N, @Cd, etc.) should be listed in vex_functions
- If code is incomplete or clearly truncated, set needs_review=true
- If code is a trivial modification of the previous snippet, note it in builds_on
- Be conservative with difficulty ratings:
  - beginner: basic attributes, simple expressions, @P/@Cd type work
  - intermediate: point clouds, loops, channel references, groups
  - advanced: matrices, quaternions, custom solvers, compiled blocks

OUTPUT: A single JSON object (not wrapped in markdown code blocks). Must conform exactly to the schema."""

SCHEMA_SUMMARY = """Required fields:
- id: string, format "joy_of_vex_ep{NN}_{NNN}"
- source: string, full episode title
- episode: integer
- timestamp: string, "MM:SS"
- youtube_url: string
- topic: string, 2-6 words
- code: string, cleaned VEX code
- explanation: string, 1-3 sentences
- vex_functions: array of strings
- vex_context: "SOP" | "DOP" | "COP" | "CVEX" | "unknown"
- node_context: string (e.g., "Attribute Wrangle")
- difficulty: "beginner" | "intermediate" | "advanced"
- category: one of [attributes, color, geometry_creation, geometry_manipulation, math_operations, noise_and_randomness, point_clouds, groups_and_selection, strings, arrays, volumes, simulation, ui_and_parameters, flow_control, debugging, optimization, other]
- related_concepts: array of strings
- prerequisites: array of IDs (can be empty)
- builds_on: string ID or null
- ocr_confidence: number 0-1
- needs_review: boolean"""


def structure_record(aligned_pair, episode_num, episode_title):
    """Send one aligned pair to Claude for structuring."""

    prompt = f"""Structure this VEX tutorial content into a JSON record.

Episode: {episode_title} (Episode {episode_num})
Timestamp: {aligned_pair['timestamp_fmt']}
YouTube URL: {aligned_pair['youtube_url']}
Sequence in episode: {aligned_pair['sequence']}

OCR'd Code (may have artifacts):
```
{aligned_pair['code_text']}
```

Transcript explanation (conversational):
{aligned_pair['explanation_raw']}

OCR Confidence: {aligned_pair['ocr_confidence']}

{SCHEMA_SUMMARY}

Output the JSON record only, no markdown wrapping."""

    try:
        response = client.messages.create(
            model="claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929",
            max_tokens=2000,
            system=SYSTEM_PROMPT,
            messages=[{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
        )

        text = response.content[0].text.strip()

        # Strip markdown code fences if present
        if text.startswith("```"):
            text = text.split("\n", 1)[1]
            if text.endswith("```"):
                text = text[:-3]
            text = text.strip()

        record = json.loads(text)
        return record

    except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
        print(f"    JSON parse error: {e}")
        return None
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"    API error: {e}")
        time.sleep(5)  # Rate limit backoff
        return None


def process_episode(aligned_file, playlist_entry):
    """Process all aligned pairs in an episode."""
    with open(aligned_file) as f:
        aligned_pairs = json.load(f)

    episode_title = (
        playlist_entry.get("title", aligned_file.stem)
        if playlist_entry
        else aligned_file.stem
    )

    # Extract episode number from filename or index
    episode_num = playlist_entry.get("index", 0) if playlist_entry else 0

    records = []
    for pair in aligned_pairs:
        print(f"    Processing sequence {pair['sequence']}...")
        record = structure_record(pair, episode_num, episode_title)

        if record:
            records.append(record)

        # Rate limiting: ~50 requests/minute for Sonnet
        time.sleep(1.5)

    return records


def main():
    # Load playlist index
    playlist_index = {}
    index_file = META_DIR / "playlist_index.json"
    if index_file.exists():
        with open(index_file) as f:
            for entry in json.load(f):
                playlist_index[entry["filename_base"]] = entry

    aligned_files = sorted(ALIGNED_DIR.glob("*.json"))

    total_records = 0
    total_review = 0

    for aligned_file in aligned_files:
        episode_name = aligned_file.stem
        playlist_entry = playlist_index.get(episode_name)

        print(f"\n--- Processing {episode_name} ---")
        records = process_episode(aligned_file, playlist_entry)

        # Write JSONL
        output_file = STRUCTURED_DIR / f"{episode_name}.jsonl"
        with open(output_file, "w") as f:
            for record in records:
                f.write(json.dumps(record, sort_keys=True) + "\n")

        review_count = sum(1 for r in records if r.get("needs_review", False))
        print(f"  {episode_name}: {len(records)} records, {review_count} need review")
        total_records += len(records)
        total_review += review_count

    print(f"\n{'=' * 50}")
    print(f"Total records: {total_records}")
    print(f"Need review: {total_review}")
    print(f"Output: {STRUCTURED_DIR}/")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def stage_1_download():
    banner(1, "Download videos + subtitles")

    # Get playlist info

    )
    entries = [json.loads(l) for l in result.stdout.strip().split("\n") if l.strip()]
    print(f"Found {len(entries)} episodes.\n")

    index_data = []
    for i, entry in enumerate(entries, 1):
        video_id = entry.get("id", entry.get("url", ""))
        title = entry.get("title", f"episode_{i}")
        safe_title = re.sub(r"[^\w\s-]", "", title).strip().replace(" ", "_")[:60]
        filename_base = f"{i:02d}_{safe_title}"

        video_file = VIDEO_DIR / f"{filename_base}.mp4"

            print(f"  [{i}/{len(entries)}] SKIP (exists): {filename_base}")

                "url": f"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={video_id}",

            continue

        print(f"  [{i}/{len(entries)}] Downloading: {title}")

            # Move VTT files from video dir to subs dir
            for vtt in VIDEO_DIR.glob(f"{filename_base}*.vtt"):
                vtt.rename(SUB_DIR / vtt.name)

# STAGE 3: Code Frame Detection (with higher diff threshold)
# ============================================================
def stage_3_detect(playlist):
    banner(3, "Detect code frames (diff_threshold=0.04)")

    import cv2
    import numpy as np

    DARK_THRESHOLD = 80
    DARK_RATIO_MIN = 0.25
    EDGE_DENSITY_MIN = 0.02
    DIFF_THRESHOLD = 0.04  # Raised from 0.015 to reduce near-duplicates

    def is_code_frame(frame):
        gray = cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
        h, w = gray.shape
        dark_mask = gray < DARK_THRESHOLD
        dark_ratio = np.sum(dark_mask) / (h * w)
        if dark_ratio < DARK_RATIO_MIN:
            return False, 0.0, {}
        edges = cv2.Canny(gray, 50, 150)
        text_edges = edges & (dark_mask.astype(np.uint8) * 255)
        edge_density = np.sum(text_edges > 0) / max(np.sum(dark_mask), 1)
        if edge_density < EDGE_DENSITY_MIN:
            return False, 0.0, {}
        horiz_k = cv2.getStructuringElement(cv2.MORPH_RECT, (25, 1))
        horiz = cv2.morphologyEx(text_edges, cv2.MORPH_OPEN, horiz_k)
        line_ratio = np.sum(horiz > 0) / max(np.sum(text_edges > 0), 1)
        conf = min(1.0, dark_ratio * 0.3 + edge_density * 10 * 0.4 + line_ratio * 0.3)
        return conf > 0.3, conf, {
            "dark_ratio": round(float(dark_ratio), 3),
            "edge_density": round(float(edge_density), 4),
            "line_ratio": round(float(line_ratio), 3),
        }

    def frames_differ(a, b):
        if a is None or b is None:
            return True
        ga = cv2.cvtColor(a, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
        gb = cv2.cvtColor(b, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
        diff = cv2.absdiff(ga, gb)
        return np.sum(diff > 30) / diff.size > DIFF_THRESHOLD

    for entry in playlist:
        if "error" in entry:
            continue
        frame_dir = FRAME_DIR / entry["filename_base"]
        out_dir = CODE_DIR / entry["filename_base"]

        if out_dir.exists() and (out_dir / "detections.json").exists():
            with open(out_dir / "detections.json") as f:
                existing = json.load(f)
            print(f"  SKIP (exists): {entry['filename_base']} ({len(existing)} detections)")
            continue

        frames = sorted(frame_dir.glob("frame_*.png"))
        if not frames:
            continue

        out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        detections = []
        last_code = None

        print(f"  Detecting: {entry['filename_base']} ({len(frames)} frames)...")
        for fp in frames:
            frame = cv2.imread(str(fp))
            if frame is None:
                continue
            is_code, conf, meta = is_code_frame(frame)
            if is_code and frames_differ(frame, last_code):
                frame_num = int(fp.stem.split("_")[1])
                ts = frame_num * 2
                shutil.copy2(fp, out_dir / fp.name)
                detections.append({
                    "frame": fp.name,
                    "timestamp_sec": ts,
                    "timestamp_fmt": f"{ts // 60}:{ts % 60:02d}",
                    "confidence": round(float(conf), 3),
                    "metadata": meta,
                })
                last_code = frame.copy()

        with open(out_dir / "detections.json", "w") as f:
            json.dump(detections, f, indent=2)
        print(f"    -> {len(detections)} unique code frames")

- If NO VEX code is visible, respond with exactly: NO_CODE
- Include attribute bindings (@P, @Cd, etc.) as they appear

Respond with ONLY the extracted code (or NO_CODE). No explanation, no markdown fences."""

    for entry in playlist:
        if "error" in entry:
            continue
        episode_name = entry["filename_base"]
        episode_dir = CODE_DIR / episode_name
        det_file = episode_dir / "detections.json"
        out_file = OCR_DIR / f"{episode_name}.json"

        if out_file.exists():
            with open(out_file) as f:
                existing = json.load(f)
            if existing and existing[0].get("extraction_method") == "claude_vision":
                print(f"  SKIP (exists): {episode_name} ({len(existing)} blocks)")
                continue

        if not det_file.exists():
            continue

        with open(det_file) as f:
            dets = json.load(f)

        print(f"  Processing: {episode_name} ({len(dets)} frames)...")
        results = []
        for i, det in enumerate(dets):
            fp = episode_dir / det["frame"]
            if not fp.exists():
                continue

            with open(fp, "rb") as f:
                img_b64 = base64.standard_b64encode(f.read()).decode("utf-8")

            try:
                resp = client.messages.create(
                    model="claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929",
                    max_tokens=1000,
                    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": [
                        {"type": "image", "source": {
                            "type": "base64", "media_type": "image/png", "data": img_b64}},
                        {"type": "text", "text": PROMPT},
                    ]}],
                )
                text = resp.content[0].text.strip()

                # Strip markdown fences if model added them
                if text.startswith("```"):
                    lines = text.split("\n")
                    text = "\n".join(lines[1:-1] if lines[-1].strip() == "```" else lines[1:])
                    text = text.strip()

                if text and text != "NO_CODE":
                    results.append({
                        "frame": det["frame"],
                        "timestamp_sec": det["timestamp_sec"],
                        "timestamp_fmt": det["timestamp_fmt"],
                        "code_text": text,
                        "ocr_confidence": 0.85,
                        "detection_confidence": det["confidence"],
                        "needs_review": False,
                        "extraction_method": "claude_vision",
                    })

            except Exception as e:
                print(f"    [{i+1}] Error: {e}")
                time.sleep(5)

            # Progress + rate limit
            if (i + 1) % 10 == 0:
                print(f"    [{i+1}/{len(dets)}] extracted {len(results)} code blocks so far")
            time.sleep(0.5)

        with open(out_file, "w") as f:
            json.dump(results, f, indent=2, sort_keys=False)

        no_code = len(dets) - len(results)
        print(f"    -> {len(results)} code blocks ({no_code} frames had no code)")


# ============================================================
# STAGE 5: Transcripts
# ============================================================
def stage_5_transcripts(playlist):
    banner(5, "Process VTT subtitles")

    import webvtt

    FILLER = [
        r"\b(um+|uh+|ah+|er+|hm+|hmm+)\b",
        r"\b(you know|like I said|basically|sort of|kind of)\b",
        r"\[.*?\]", r"\(.*?\)",
    ]

    def clean(text):
        for p in FILLER:
            text = re.sub(p, "", text, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
        return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()

    def time_to_sec(t):
        parts = t.replace(",", ".").split(":")
        if len(parts) == 3:
            return int(parts[0]) * 3600 + int(parts[1]) * 60 + float(parts[2])
        return int(parts[0]) * 60 + float(parts[1]) if len(parts) == 2 else 0

    for entry in playlist:
        if "error" in entry:
            continue
        ep = entry["filename_base"]
        out_file = TRANSCRIPT_DIR / f"{ep}.json"

        if out_file.exists():
            print(f"  SKIP (exists): {ep}")
            continue

        # Find VTT file
        vtt_candidates = list(SUB_DIR.glob(f"{ep}*"))
        if not vtt_candidates:
            print(f"  NO VTT: {ep}")
            continue

        vtt_path = vtt_candidates[0]
        segments = []
        try:
            for cap in webvtt.read(str(vtt_path)):
                text = clean(cap.text)
                if text and len(text) > 5:
                    segments.append({
                        "start": cap.start, "end": cap.end,
                        "start_sec": time_to_sec(cap.start),
                        "end_sec": time_to_sec(cap.end),
                        "text": text,
                    })
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"  ERROR parsing {vtt_path.name}: {e}")
            continue

        # Merge nearby segments
        merged = [segments[0].copy()] if segments else []
        for seg in segments[1:]:
            last = merged[-1]
            if seg["start_sec"] - last["end_sec"] < 2.0 and len(last["text"]) + len(seg["text"]) < 500:
                last["end"] = seg["end"]
                last["end_sec"] = seg["end_sec"]
                last["text"] += " " + seg["text"]
            else:
                merged.append(seg.copy())

        with open(out_file, "w") as f:
            json.dump(merged, f, indent=2)
        print(f"  {ep}: {len(merged)} segments")


# ============================================================
# STAGE 6: Alignment
# ============================================================
def stage_6_align(playlist):
    banner(6, "Temporal alignment")

    BEFORE = 30
    AFTER = 15

    playlist_index = {e["filename_base"]: e for e in playlist if "error" not in e}

    for ocr_file in sorted(OCR_DIR.glob("*.json")):
        ep = ocr_file.stem
        out_file = ALIGNED_DIR / f"{ep}.json"

        # Don't skip - re-align with latest OCR
        with open(ocr_file) as f:
            ocr_data = json.load(f)
        if not ocr_data:
            continue

        trans_file = TRANSCRIPT_DIR / f"{ep}.json"
        if not trans_file.exists():
            candidates = list(TRANSCRIPT_DIR.glob(f"{ep.split('.')[0]}*"))
            trans_file = candidates[0] if candidates else None
        if not trans_file or not trans_file.exists():
            print(f"  No transcript for {ep}")
            continue

        with open(trans_file) as f:
            transcript = json.load(f)

        aligned = []
        for i, cb in enumerate(ocr_data):
            ts = cb["timestamp_sec"]
            explanation = " ".join(
                seg["text"] for seg in transcript
                if seg.get("start_sec", 0) <= ts + AFTER
                and seg.get("end_sec", seg.get("start_sec", 0) + 5) >= ts - BEFORE
            )

            entry_meta = playlist_index.get(ep, {})
            vid = entry_meta.get("video_id", "")
            url = f"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={vid}&t={int(ts)}s" if vid else ""

            aligned.append({
                "sequence": i + 1,
                "episode_name": ep,
                "timestamp_sec": ts,
                "timestamp_fmt": cb["timestamp_fmt"],
                "youtube_url": url,
                "code_text": cb["code_text"],
                "explanation_raw": explanation,
                "ocr_confidence": cb["ocr_confidence"],
                "needs_review": cb.get("needs_review", False),
            })

        with open(out_file, "w") as f:
            json.dump(aligned, f, indent=2)
        print(f"  {ep}: {len(aligned)} aligned pairs")


# ============================================================
# STAGE 7: LLM Structuring
# ============================================================
def stage_7_structure(playlist):
    banner(7, "LLM structuring with Claude")

    from anthropic import Anthropic
    client = Anthropic(api_key=os.environ["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"])

    playlist_index = {e["filename_base"]: e for e in playlist if "error" not in e}

    SYSTEM = """You are a Houdini VEX expert structuring tutorial content for a RAG database.

You receive OCR'd VEX code and transcript explanation. Produce a structured JSON record.

RULES:
- Fix obvious OCR errors in code
- Ensure code is syntactically valid VEX
- Write explanation in clear technical prose (1-3 sentences)
- Extract ALL VEX functions and attribute bindings (@P, @Cd, etc.)
- If code has multiple variants separated by ---, keep only the most complete/final version
- Be conservative with difficulty ratings:
  beginner: basic attributes, simple expressions
  intermediate: point clouds, loops, channels, groups
  advanced: matrices, quaternions, custom solvers

OUTPUT: A single JSON object, no markdown wrapping."""

    SCHEMA = """Required fields:
- id: "joy_of_vex_ep{NN}_{NNN}"
- source: full episode title
- episode: integer
- timestamp: "MM:SS"
- youtube_url: string
- topic: 2-6 words
- code: cleaned VEX (single best version)
- explanation: 1-3 sentences
- vex_functions: array of strings
- vex_context: "SOP"|"DOP"|"COP"|"CVEX"|"unknown"
- node_context: e.g. "Attribute Wrangle"
- difficulty: "beginner"|"intermediate"|"advanced"
- category: one of [attributes, color, geometry_creation, geometry_manipulation, math_operations, noise_and_randomness, point_clouds, groups_and_selection, strings, arrays, volumes, simulation, ui_and_parameters, flow_control, debugging, optimization, other]
- related_concepts: array of strings
- prerequisites: array of IDs (can be [])
- builds_on: string ID or null
- ocr_confidence: number 0-1
- needs_review: boolean"""

    for aligned_file in sorted(ALIGNED_DIR.glob("*.json")):
        ep = aligned_file.stem
        out_file = STRUCTURED_DIR / f"{ep}.jsonl"

        if out_file.exists() and out_file.stat().st_size > 10:
            with open(out_file) as f:
                lines = [l for l in f if l.strip()]
            print(f"  SKIP (exists): {ep} ({len(lines)} records)")
            continue

        with open(aligned_file) as f:
            pairs = json.load(f)
        if not pairs:
            continue

        meta = playlist_index.get(ep, {})
        title = meta.get("title", ep)
        ep_num = meta.get("index", 0)

        print(f"  Processing: {ep} ({len(pairs)} pairs)...")
        records = []
        for pair in pairs:
            prompt = f"""Structure this VEX tutorial content into a JSON record.

Episode: {title} (Episode {ep_num})
Timestamp: {pair['timestamp_fmt']}
YouTube URL: {pair['youtube_url']}
Sequence: {pair['sequence']}

VEX Code:
{pair['code_text']}

Transcript context:
{pair['explanation_raw'][:1000]}

OCR Confidence: {pair['ocr_confidence']}

{SCHEMA}

Output JSON only."""

            try:
                resp = client.messages.create(
                    model="claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929",
                    max_tokens=2000,
                    system=SYSTEM,
                    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
                )
                text = resp.content[0].text.strip()
                if text.startswith("```"):
                    text = text.split("\n", 1)[1]
                    if text.endswith("```"):
                        text = text[:-3]
                    text = text.strip()
                records.append(json.loads(text))
            except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
                print(f"    seq={pair['sequence']}: JSON error: {e}")
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"    seq={pair['sequence']}: API error: {e}")
                time.sleep(5)

            time.sleep(1.0)

        with open(out_file, "w") as f:
            for r in records:
                f.write(json.dumps(r, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
        review = sum(1 for r in records if r.get("needs_review"))
        print(f"    -> {len(records)} records ({review} need review)")


# ============================================================
# STAGE 8: Validation + Assembly
# ============================================================
def stage_8_validate():
    banner(8, "Validation + final assembly")
    # Delegate to the existing script
    subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, str(PROJECT_DIR / "scripts" / "08_validate_and_assemble.py")],
        cwd=str(PROJECT_DIR),
        check=True,
    )


# ============================================================
# MAIN
# ============================================================
def main():
    if not os.environ.get("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"):
        print("ERROR: Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable")
        sys.exit(1)

    start = time.time()

    # Stage 1
    if RESUME_FROM <= 1 and not SKIP_DOWNLOAD:
        playlist = stage_1_download()
    else:
        with open(META_DIR / "playlist_index.json") as f:
            playlist = json.load(f)
        print(f"Loaded playlist index: {len(playlist)} episodes")

    valid = [e for e in playlist if "error" not in e]
    print(f"\n{len(valid)} episodes ready for processing.\n")

    # Stage 2
    if RESUME_FROM <= 2 and not SKIP_FRAMES:
        stage_2_frames(valid)

    # Stage 3
    if RESUME_FROM <= 3:
        stage_3_detect(valid)

    # Stage 4b (Vision OCR) + Stage 5 (Transcripts) -- independent, but sequential
    if RESUME_FROM <= 4:
        stage_5_transcripts(valid)  # Fast, run first
        stage_4_vision_ocr(valid)   # Slow, run after

    if RESUME_FROM <= 5 and RESUME_FROM > 4:
        stage_5_transcripts(valid)

    # Stage 6
    if RESUME_FROM <= 6:
        stage_6_align(valid)

    # Stage 7
    if RESUME_FROM <= 7:
        stage_7_structure(valid)

    # Stage 8
    stage_8_validate()

    elapsed = time.time() - start
    print(f"\n{'=' * 60}")
    print(f"  PIPELINE COMPLETE in {elapsed / 60:.1f} minutes")
    print(f"{'=' * 60}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
